about: What each named bot says at the table, and when. Built from BOT's Personality.MD. Keys under 'bots' are roster keys (common/bot_roster.py). A line fires on any of its triggers, with its own chance, at most max_per_game times, and not again within cooldown_seconds. See personality/table_talk.py for how triggers are detected.

triggers.outbid_repeat_raiser: The bot outbids an opponent who has raised two or more times this auction.
triggers.keeps_raising: The bot raises for the third time or more in one auction.
triggers.aggressive_rival: The bot raises over an opponent who has outbid it three or more times this game.
triggers.challenge_opponent: An opponent starts deciding whether to raise right after the bot raised.
triggers.opponent_hesitates: That opponent is still deciding a few seconds later.
triggers.opponent_slow: An opponent is taking a long time over any move.
triggers.won_auction: The bot wins a painting or prestige card.
triggers.won_valuable: The bot wins a valuable card: a prestige card or a painting worth 7 or more.
triggers.won_uncontested: The bot wins a card nobody else bid on.
triggers.won_contested: The bot wins a card after an opponent bid on it and then passed.
triggers.lost_auction: The bot bid on a card someone else won.
triggers.losing_streak: The bot has lost three auctions in a row that it bid in.
triggers.took_disgrace: The bot is stuck with a disgrace card.
triggers.comeback: The bot was last on points after the fourth auction and is now first.
triggers.lost_game: The bot lost the game but wasn't knocked out.
triggers.eliminated: The bot finished with the least money and was knocked out.
triggers.opponent_eliminated: An opponent finished with the least money and was knocked out.
triggers.game_tied: The bot shares the win with someone.
